title: necessitating
description: The modal box operation of the valuation: it lowers each cell's charge to the knowledge-meet of the charges assigned at that cell across the fiber-algebras, appending a new knowledge-monotone valuation to the trace. Deflationary ('what must hold') and right adjoint of possibilizing's diamond.

morphism.description: a one-way generative arrow; the box that lowers each cell to the knowledge-meet of its charges across the fiber-algebras

domain.description: the valuation it maps out of - the charge assignment over the trace's cells

codomain.description: a new knowledge-monotone valuation v' appended to the trace, each cell deflated to the knowledge-meet of its charges across the fiber-algebras
